audit_scope: Blind qualitative audit of nine actual replies against the supplied intent; no source, condition mapping, prior judges, runtime execution, or process-compliance claims used.
limitations: One sample per record is descriptive evidence only, not a statistical or causal comparison.
Diagram suitability was assessed visually from text; exact display-width alignment was not measured.
Draft contents were treated as supporting artifacts, not automatically as conversation wording.
Severity: high = premature or contradictory decision request; medium = materially avoidable ambiguity or disproportionate presentation; low = localized wording or repetition.
